description: This file defines an abstract base class 'Fetcher' for data fetching operations, including methods for transforming queries, extracting data asynchronously or synchronously, transforming data, and testing fetcher implementations. It also includes a 'classproperty' decorator for class-level properties.

classes.name: classproperty
classes.description: Decorator class to define class-level properties.

classes.name: Fetcher
classes.description: Abstract generic class for data fetchers, providing methods for query transformation, data extraction, data transformation, and testing.

methods.name: transform_query
methods.description: Transforms input parameters into a provider-specific query object.

methods.name: aextract_data
methods.description: Asynchronously extracts data from the provider given a query and optional credentials.

methods.name: extract_data
methods.description: Synchronously extracts data from the provider given a query and optional credentials.

methods.name: transform_data
methods.description: Transforms provider-specific data into the desired format or annotated result.

methods.name: __init_subclass__
methods.description: Initializes subclasses, ensuring they implement either 'extract_data' or 'aextract_data'.

methods.name: fetch_data
methods.description: Fetches data from the provider by transforming the query, extracting data asynchronously, and transforming the data.

methods.name: query_params_type
methods.description: Class property returning the type of query parameters.

methods.name: return_type
methods.description: Class property returning the return type.

methods.name: data_type
methods.description: Class property returning the data type.

methods.name: _get_data_type
methods.description: Static method to determine the data type, especially if it's a list.

methods.name: test
methods.description: Method to test the fetcher implementation, verifying query transformation, data extraction, and data transformation steps.
